standard:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Edit target: the large left icon in the attached Homer VERMILION concept board selected by the user. Deliver ONLY ONE finished app icon asset, not a board.
Output: square 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG. Genuine alpha transparency outside the rounded-square tile. No off-white canvas, no typography, no thumbnails, no mockup, no screenshot.
Preserve the selected identity: a friendly HIPPOPOTAMUS head leaning subtly upward to the right in near-front three-quarter view, exceptionally broad low creamy ivory muzzle, two small round ears, two tiny dark round eyes above the muzzle, two dark oval nostrils, warm small asymmetric confident smile. Retain its graphic playful silhouette, warm orange head and cream snout. No body or accessories.
Refine for production: a richly saturated warm vermilion red-orange tile (#F24B32) and a lighter burnt-orange head (#EF8457), one deeper rust side plane (#B93628), luminous creamy ivory muzzle (#FFF0D5), near-charcoal features (#302828). Clearly separate head and ears from red-orange background, with strong broad silhouette and carefully balanced negative space. Keep the near-front gentle three-quarter tilt recognizable from the selected concept. Ears and forehead visible. Avoid a pig snout disk, bear face, bull horns, sad eyes, open mouth, infantile huge eyes. Keep one clean short smile visible at 32px. Features should be bold and uncomplicated. No texture, grain, fur, thin outlines or busy highlights.
MacOS continuous rounded-square tile centered in entire square image, with approximately 8 percent transparent safety margin on every side (tile spans x=82..942 y=82..942 on a 1024 canvas). Native macOS icon proportions; all content within tile. The hippo head fills about 82 percent of tile width. Smooth precision edges; very restrained shallow cut-paper relief, small soft shading at shape overlaps, subtle tile edge lighting; confident professional graphic mascot, not a plastic toy or photoreal animal.
No hard external drop shadow, no floor or pedestal. All outside tile is truly transparent. Do not add H, wordmark, badge, stars, orbit, sparkles, teeth, glasses, hair, clothing, app UI, presentation border or watermark. Preserve the original concept's friendly demeanor; this is the polished standard version.
standardTransparencyPass: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Edit this exact supplied Homer app icon. Preserve the entire icon design, hippo face, smile, eyes, ears, pose, orange and cream colors, rounded-square tile, scale and position. Do not redesign ANY of the interior. Fix ONLY exterior transparency: remove ALL scattered red/orange speckles, dust, isolated pixels, halos and residue outside the rounded-square tile. Make every pixel outside the tile truly alpha-transparent, clean smooth anti-aliased edge, no fringe, no background color, no checkerboard. Keep the full square canvas and the same approximately 8 percent transparent margin outside the continuous rounded-square tile. This is a final production app icon cutout, 1024 x 1024 square RGBA PNG. One icon only, no presentation or text. Do not add a floor shadow. The tile and all mascot interior must remain opaque; exterior fully transparent.
cool:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand. Edit the supplied finalized Homer vermilion app icon into a subtle COOL counterpart. Output ONLY ONE icon asset, square 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with genuine transparency outside tile. Not a board.

Preserve the exact red-orange continuous rounded-square tile, creamy ivory enormous broad muzzle, orange head, two circular ears, friendly near-front three-quarter tilt, pose, overall proportions, scale, light and color palette of the reference. The user likes this exact direction, so keep 90 percent of it unchanged. No body, no new animal, no cropped ears.

Change ONLY expression and eyewear to introduce understated cool confidence: add a pair of beautifully integrated compact matte charcoal wayfarer-like SUNGLASSES covering the two small eyes ABOVE the muzzle, angled with the face. Lenses are clean bold black/charcoal geometric shapes with rounded outer corners, joined by a restrained short bridge. Keep both nostrils on the cream snout exactly in place and fully visible: sunglasses must not be mistaken for nostrils or cover the muzzle. No mirror reflections, no blue glow, no tiny rim lines, no fine decorative details. A single restrained warm highlight on lens upper edge is acceptable, but readable flat shapes are paramount. Slightly shorten and lift one corner of the existing smile into a knowing relaxed smirk. Friendly, competent, effortlessly cool; no angry eyebrows, villain grin, bared teeth, aggressive fangs, baby cheeks. Keep ear/forehead silhouette visible above glasses.

Keep original vermilion tile separated from orange head with deeper rust side plane, ivory muzzle and charcoal features. Keep minimal shallow cut-paper relief and optical balance. No photoreal textures, no plastic toy sheen, no new shadows outside tile, no star, sparkle, letter, typography, badges, headphones, hats, clothes, neon or background. The tile stays centered with about 8 percent transparent margin on all four sides, matching the exact original icon footprint. Transparent external area should be clean, no isolated particles, no red speckle residue. Interior opaque. Deliver the actual icon image only.
